title: Gamification of Virtual Language Learning: A Case Study with Thai Undergraduate Students
reason: Qualitative focus-group study with 27 undergraduates used to design a gamified Moodle course; the course is proposed, not evaluated. No platform-recorded indicator or activity product is related to success or a construct.

extraction.n_quote: The data was collected from 27 undergraduate
extraction.population: undergraduate hospitality management (business major) students learning English, 1 university
extraction.lms_indicators: none (proposed Moodle Level Up! points and badges, not deployed)
extraction.notes: Secondary: NONEMP for the framework part (design proposal without outcome data).
